errors.NOT_CONNECTED: The account is not connected. Reconnect it in Settings.
errors.UPLOAD_SESSION_EXPIRED: The upload session expired; it will start again.
errors.FILE_UNAVAILABLE: The file is no longer available or has changed.

accounts.title: Connected accounts
accounts.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect {{name}}? Omnyra will revoke its access and delete the tokens from the system keyring. Data already saved is kept.
accounts.waitingBrowser: Finish signing in to {{name}} in the browser window that opened…
accounts.notConfigured: This network's client ID is missing from the build's .env file.
accounts.empty: Connect your first network to get started.
accounts.needsReauthHint: Access has expired or been revoked. Reconnect the account to keep syncing.
accounts.notRevoked: The account was disconnected and its tokens were deleted from this computer, but the platform could not be notified (offline?). You can remove Omnyra's access manually.
accounts.deviceCode: Confirm this code on the {{name}} page that opened in your browser:

scopes.ytReadonly: View your YouTube channel and videos
scopes.ytForceSsl: Manage your YouTube account (playlists and comments)
scopes.igComments: Instagram: read and reply to comments

bestTime.title: Best time to publish
bestTime.indicative: Indicative only: views of unlisted videos depend on where you share the link, not on when you publish.
bestTime.insufficient: Not enough data: {{sample}} {{format}} have first-week data and {{needed}} are needed.
bestTime.tryUnlisted: You can include unlisted ones for an indicative result.
bestTime.noStandout: No moment clearly stands out from the usual.
bestTime.footnote: First-week views compared with the channel's usual; {{sample}} {{format}}, recent ones count more. Time zone: {{tz}}.

upload.auditWarning: Google locks videos uploaded from apps that have not passed its audit (like this one, for now) as private. You can publish them later from YouTube Studio. Choosing Public or Unlisted still uploads them as private.
upload.needsScope: Omnyra needs permission to upload videos to this channel. Google will open so you can grant it; pick the same channel.
upload.needsPlaylistScope: To add the video to a playlist, Omnyra also needs permission to manage your YouTube account. Google will open; pick the same channel.
upload.title: Title
upload.madeForKids: Is it made for kids? (required by law, COPPA)

warning.thumbnail_not_allowed: Thumbnail not set: YouTube only allows custom thumbnails on phone-verified channels.
warning.playlist_scope: Not added to the playlist: permission missing.
warning.playlist_quota: Not added to the playlist: quota exhausted.
warning.playlist_failed: Could not add to the playlist.
warning.thumbnail_ignored: The thumbnail was ignored (not supported through the API).
warning.posted_private: Posted as private: TikTok only allows that for unaudited apps.

file.unreadable: The file is not a valid video.
file.format: Format not supported by this network.
file.no_video: The file has no video track.
file.too_long: The video exceeds the maximum length of {{limit}}.
file.needs_verification: Longer than {{limit}}: your channel must be phone-verified.
file.probe_unavailable: FFmpeg is not installed: the file's length and content cannot be checked.
file.not_vertical: The video is not vertical and will show with bars. Use the 9:16 version from multi-network publishing.

title.too_long: The title allows at most {{limit}} characters.

description.too_long: The description allows at most {{limit}} bytes.
description.too_many_hashtags: With more than {{limit}} hashtags, YouTube ignores all of them.
description.caption_too_long: The full caption is longer than {{limit}} characters.

tags.too_long: Tags add up to more than {{limit}} characters.
tags.invalid_chars: A tag is empty or contains < or >.

visibility.private_until_audit: It will be uploaded as private (see the notice above).
visibility.always_public: Everything published on Instagram is public.
visibility.tiktok_private_until_audit: Until the TikTok app is audited, posts are private (and your account must be private).

thumbnail.format: The thumbnail must be JPG or PNG.
thumbnail.ignored: This network does not accept a thumbnail through the API: ignored.

platform.upload_not_supported: This network does not support uploads from Omnyra.

playlist.ignored: This network has no playlists: ignored.

upload.captionHint: This network has no title: text, description and tags (as hashtags) make up the caption.
upload.scheduledFor: Scheduled for {{at}} (Omnyra must be open or in the tray).

twitch.observedNote: Viewers are only known for streams Omnyra saw while it was open ({{observed}} of {{streams}}): Twitch keeps no such history. Hours and stream count also include the VODs Twitch keeps.
twitch.followersNote: History is computed from the date each current follower followed you; people who unfollowed no longer appear.
twitch.noSessions: None in this period. Omnyra records streams while it is open.

calendar.hint: Click a day (or an hour, in week view) to set the reminder's date. Drag reminders, ideas and scheduled publications to reschedule them; published content cannot be moved.

ideas.title: Title
ideas.filesNote: Files are not copied: Omnyra only stores their path and never deletes them.

prefs.title: Background & notifications
prefs.tray: Keep running when the window is closed
prefs.trayHint: Closing the window keeps Omnyra in the system tray.
prefs.autostartHint: Start Omnyra automatically when you sign in.
prefs.backgroundSyncHint: Refresh metrics periodically while the app is open.
prefs.notificationsHint: Reminders, milestones and video performance alerts.

shortform.noteInstagram: Instagram only serves 30 days of daily insights: history fills in while you use Omnyra. Views, likes and comments are those of the posts in the period.
shortform.noteTiktok: TikTok has no history: followers are recorded daily since you connected the account. Figures are those of the videos published in the period.

publish.intro: Pick the video once, add the target accounts and adjust each version. Omnyra renders every format with FFmpeg and uploads it in the background.
publish.exportHint: For networks without API upload (or to upload by hand): render the file in the chosen format and copy the text to the clipboard.

community.noAccounts: No connected account supports comments (YouTube and Instagram do; Twitch and TikTok do not allow it through the API).
